breakdown.description: The symmetry edges are replaced by full clamps
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly imposes only the normal displacement component on each symmetry edge: u_x = 0 on x = 0 and u_y = 0 on y = 0. It does not fully clamp those edges (i.e., it does not constrain both displacement components on either symmetry boundary), which matches the ground truth's instruction to impose symmetry only on the normal displacement component.
